v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dómine, * probásti me et cognovísti me. ‡
text.en: Lord, * thou hast proved me, and known me. ‡

text.la: Mirabília ópera tua, * Dómine, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
text.en: Wonderful are thy works * and my soul knoweth right well.

text.la: Ne derelínquas me, * Dómine, virtus salútis meæ.
text.en: Do not thou forsake me, * O Lord, the strength of my salvation.

text.la: Dómine, * clamávi ad te, exáudi me. ‡
text.en: I have cried to thee, * O Lord, hear me. ‡

text.la: Educ de custódia * ánimam meam, Dómine, ad confiténdum nómini tuo.
text.en: Bring my soul * out of prison, O Lord, that I may praise thy name.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui suffert tentatiónem: quóniam cum probátus fúerit, accípiet corónam vitæ, quam repromísit Deus diligéntibus se.
text.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation; for when he hath been proved, he shall receive a crown of life, which God hath promised to them that love him.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Qui vult veníre post me, * ábneget semetípsum, et tollat crucem suam, et sequátur me.
text.en: If any man will come after me, * let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me.

text.la: Gregem tuum, Pastor ætérne, placátus inténde: et, per beátum Martínum Mártyrem tuum atque Summum Pontíficem, perpétua protectióne custódi; quem totíus Ecclésiæ præstitísti esse pastórem.
text.en: Look forgivingly on thy flock, Eternal Shepherd, and keep it in thy constant protection, by the intercession of blessed Martin thy Martyr and Sovereign Pontiff, whom thou didst constitute Shepherd of the whole Church.
